page.overview:
What is Justice Medley?

Justice Medley is a medley song by Metallica. The medley is a combination of songs from ...And Justice for All.

In this version "...And Justice for All" was extended to 53 seconds more. It was played on the first couple of shows from the 1st half of the North America leg of the Wherever We May Roam Tour.

In the new version "...And Justice for All" was shortened. This was played on the 1st and 2nd half of the Wherever We May Roam Tour (91-92) and the Nowhere Else To Roam Tour (1993).
